overall_notes: The engineering shell is strong: a type-clean codebase with about 3,600 green tests, clean sitemaps, a mostly WCAG-clean UI, a real action layer (save, share, three calendar options, sticky ticket bar), backups and a provenance deploy gate. What users actually get is weaker. The data is thin (4 events 'today', 3 exhibitions, 4 free events), while about 240 real Athens events are hidden by whitelist gaps. Invented values reach pages, ICS files and schema: every megaron row at 20:30, including an 11:00 toddler show and a free 19:00 lecture; RA 23:59 placeholders; doorTime equal to start. A same-name venue collision sent a sold-out concert's map to the wrong neighbourhood. Greek-default pages show English prose. Measurement, the INTENT focus #1, is mostly null or months stale. Scores reflect the local build of 2026-09-23 00:23. The live site lags it (live homepage 110KB decoded vs 469KB local), and I did not score the live site separately.
